2608.23811.title: Generating Biomedical Fact-Checking Reports with RL-Enhanced Agentic Search
2608.23811.paper_summary: Automated fact-checking is essential for ensuring the reliability of public health information, yet the biomedical domain poses unique challenges. Validating biomedical claims requires rigorous interpretation of scientific literature, assessment of retrieved evidence, and comprehensive justification toward the conclusion. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) enhanced by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic search perform automated fact-checking in a retrieve-then-verify paradigm, current methods still output isolated prediction labels, lacking explanatory depth and offers limited utility for human understanding. To bridge this gap, we introduce an LLM-based agent named BioCheck Agent that generates structured biomedical fact-checking reports with agentic search. Rather than merely outputting supported or refuted labels, our agent synthesizes final conclusions with retrieved evidence and rigorous analysis. To ensure domain-specific accuracy, BioCheck Agent exclusively searches high-quality scientific literature in PubMed, utilizing advanced Boolean search operators. Recognizing that direct prompting often results in hallucinations and low-quality reports, especially for lightweight open-source models, we further propose the Evidence-Grounded Group Relative Policy Optimization (EG-GRPO) to perform reinforcement learning on BioCheck Agent with a task-specific reward that incentivizes advanced search behavior and high-quality evidence retrieval while penalizing hallucinations. Our experimental results show that compared to the base model Qwen3.5-4B, BioCheck Agent with EG-GRPO improves label prediction accuracy on SciFact by 9.95%. Furthermore, it achieves a 3.7% higher evidence quality score and a 19.63% lower evidence hallucination rate, demonstrating its ability to generate biomedical fact-checking reports with improved accuracy and quality.
2608.23811.paper_summary_zh: 自動化事實查核對於確保公共健康資訊的可靠性至關重要，但生物醫學領域面臨獨特的挑戰。驗證生物醫學主張需要對科學文獻進行嚴格的解釋、評估檢索到的證據，並對結論進行全面的論證。儘管增強型檢索生成（RAG）和代理搜索的大型語言模型（LLMs）在檢索後驗證的範式中執行自動化事實查核，但目前的方法仍然輸出孤立的預測標籤，缺乏解釋深度，並對人類理解的實用性有限。為了填補這一空白，我們介紹了一個基於LLM的代理，名為BioCheck Agent，它生成結構化的生物醫學事實查核報告，並進行代理搜索。我們的代理不僅僅是輸出支持或反駁的標籤，而是綜合檢索到的證據和嚴謹的分析來形成最終結論。為了確保領域特定的準確性，BioCheck Agent專門在PubMed中搜尋高質量的科學文獻，利用先進的布林搜索運算符。我們認識到直接提示往往會導致幻覺和低質量報告，特別是對於輕量級的開源模型，因此我們進一步提出了基於證據的群體相對政策優化（EG-GRPO），以對BioCheck Agent進行強化學習，並使用特定任務的獎勵來激勵進階搜索行為和高質量證據的檢索，同時懲罰幻覺。我們的實驗結果顯示，與基礎模型Qwen3.5-4B相比，使用EG-GRPO的BioCheck Agent在SciFact上的標籤預測準確率提高了9.95%。此外，它的證據質量得分提高了3.7%，證據幻覺率降低了19.63%，顯示出其生成生物醫學事實查核報告的準確性和質量均有所提升。
